scope: All source-derived members of four overlapping families; excludes rituals and deferred Phase 9 review list. Route assessment is not live execution.

families.title: Speed penalties
families.definition: All nonritual, non-review source descriptions with explicit penalty/penalties/reduction to Speed wording, including possessives and all-Speeds variants (preambles and non-save workflows included).

families.title: Saving throws combining direct damage and conditions
families.definition: Primary saves with structured nonpersistent damage and at least one outcome condition.

families.title: Saving throws with fixed or turn-boundary conditions
families.definition: Primary saves with an outcome condition whose compiled duration is fixed or turn-boundary.

families.title: Inherited save outcomes referring to an existing duration
families.definition: Source save-degree clauses with an explicit As [degree] clause and a reference to the duration of the inherited effect or spell in that outcome.
